question: At matched per-task sample draws and task-specific LR sequence, does simultaneous balanced-batch optimization recover the task0 gate missed by sequential homogeneous task batches?

evidence_basis.current_seed2001_joint4_homogeneous_batc: 10/20 paired, 5/5 fixed init3; the 11/20 paired gate is missed
evidence_basis.historical_joint4_mixed_batch8_seed1000: 14/20 task0 paired, 4/5 fixed init3; not a matched-seed comparison
evidence_basis.retrospective_schedule_audit: The seed2001 homogeneous joint implementation matches nominal per-task sample slots and LR vectors to the 40k single-task reference; no underexposure is supported by that audit.
evidence_basis.existing_action_profile: Gross near-zero-action collapse was falsified; saved joint loss traces show longer, less-direct end-effector paths, but no object/goal-relative mechanism was established.

hypothesis.claim_to_test: With training seed 2001, combining task gradients in each optimizer update may restore task0 paired success at matched per-task sample and LR exposure, relative to the completed homogeneous-batch2 4-task checkpoint.
hypothesis.falsifier: The new mixed-batch8 checkpoint scores below 11/20 paired task0 successes or below 5/5 fixed-init3 successes under the frozen evaluation protocol.
hypothesis.interpretation_limit: One matched training-seed contrast changes batch size and gradient co-averaging together. A pass/fail is diagnostic evidence about this training treatment, not a population-level estimate or isolated proof of multi-task interference. Existing failed outcomes remain unchanged.

options_compared.option: Advance directly to 8 tasks or unlock Fold02
options_compared.reason: The completed 4-task seed2001 model missed the unchanged task0 11/20 gate; adding tasks would compound an unresolved 4-task retention issue.

options_compared.option: Extend the same homogeneous-batch2 checkpoint or blindly repeat it
options_compared.reason: Per-task exposure and LR sequence were already matched, and the 80k-to-160k task0 comparison was non-monotonic; no new falsifiable contrast supports more of the same.
It tests training-seed variation but not the concrete update-composition hypothesis and costs four times as many optimizer updates as the selected contrast.

options_compared.option: One seed2001 mixed-batch8 4-task condition, exactly two examples/task/update
options_compared.reason: It uses the already-tested task-quota sampler, preserves the same dataset/base/seed and per-task 80,000 draws plus the 40k single-task LR vector, while changing the optimizer update composition as the explicit treatment.

proposed_training.initialization: same pretrained base as the completed seed2001 single and joint runs; no warm start from either trained checkpoint
proposed_training.batch_quota: exactly 2 samples from each of task ids 0,1,2,3 in every optimizer batch
proposed_training.lr_schedule: the exact frozen task0 40k scheduler/config vector: cosine_decay_with_warmup, 3000 warmup steps, 90000 decay steps, peak 1e-4, decay 2.5e-6; verify all 40,000 values and step ordering in preflight

evaluation.fixed_init3: one paired init3 plus four additional repeats, for 5 total

unchanged_gates.task0: at least 11/20 paired and 5/5 fixed-init3 successes
unchanged_gates.tasks1_to_3: at least 10/20 paired and 5/5 fixed-init3 successes each
unchanged_gates.8_task_expansion: LOCKED until a reviewed 4-task condition meets the existing gates

stop_conditions: Any source/config/scheduler/hash/schema mismatch, insufficient resources, path collision, occupied lock or process/GPU conflict stops before the next mutating stage.
Training failure or supervisor timeout preserves all artifacts; no automatic relaunch or evaluation.
Evaluation protocol mismatch or any runtime error preserves the failed run; no retry or result substitution.
